verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents OAuth2/OIDC flows, device authorization grant, client credentials, and fine-grained authorization services, but nowhere mentions CIBA (Client-Initiated Backchannel Authentication) or any mechanism for out-of-band human approval tied to a specific agent-initiated transaction. Device grant is a different flow (device-initiated, browser-based user authorization) rather than a backend-initiated async approval-of-transaction pattern.
